items.claim: McVey is susceptible to being submitted if he doesn't finish the fight early.
items.quote: there's a real chance that he just gets subbed because that's kind of the way he seems to fight.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is a former light heavyweight who moved up to heavyweight.
items.quote: former light heavyweight moves up to heavyweight.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino possesses pretty good power in his striking.
items.quote: He seems to have some pretty good power.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino has developed a good jab later in his career.
items.quote: The jab is something that came along late, but it's there now, and he does a good job with it.

items.claim: Vitor Petrino has defensive liabilities with not great striking defense and low hands.
items.quote: his striking defense isn't great, and his hands are generally pretty low

items.claim: Vitor Petrino is the better striker in this matchup.
items.quote: I do think he is the better striker
